items.title: 33.1 Pani ki khasiyatein aur mayaar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of properties and quality of water (PDF 247-249).

blocks.text: Pani ki kimiyai aur tabai khasiyatein aabi zakhiron mein aaloodgi ki nau'iyat aur had ke mutale ke liye markazi hain. Pani ka molecule (H2O) mustaqil dipole hai, aur yeh polarity pani ko aisi munfarid khasiyatein deti hai jo zindagi aur mahol ke liye zaruri hain.

items: Hararati mustahkami: polarity se pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds bante hain. Hydrogen bonding pani ko zyada specific heat capacity aur zyada heat of vaporisation deti hai, is liye bare aabi zakhire darja hararat ki tez tabdeeli ka muqabla karte hain.

Munfarid solvent: polarity pani ko bohat se ionic maddon, jaise metal ions, nitrates (NO3-) aur phosphates (PO4 3-), ke liye ions ko gher kar achha solvent banati hai. Kyunke pani polar organic compounds bhi gholta hai, bohat se pesticides aur herbicides aasani se pani ke chakkar (water cycle) mein dakhil hote, wahan der tak rehte aur bioaccumulation karte hain.

Amphoteric fitrat: pani acid aur base dono ka kaam kar sakta hai. Is ki self-ionisation (25 C par Kw = 1.0 x 10^-14) pH scale ki bunyaad hai. Zyada tar aabi zindagi pH ki tabdeeli se bohat hassas hai. Tezabi barish, ghuli sulphur dioxide aur nitrogen oxides se, hydronium ions (H3O+) ka concentration barhati hai; yeh tezabiyat aluminium hydroxide aur lead salts jaise zehreele metal compounds ko protonation se hal-pazeeri barha kar ya mineral satah se hata kar tah (sediments) se pani mein la sakti hai.

Redox potential: yeh napta hai ke aabi zakhira kitna oxidising ya reducing hai. Achhi oxygen wale pani mein maddey apni sab se oxidised shakal mein hote hain, jaise SO4 2- aur CO2. Aaloodah ya thehre pani mein jahan oxygen khatam ho, halaat reducing ho jate aur hydrogen sulphide (H2S) aur ammonia (NH3) jaise zehreele maddey bante hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: darmiyan mein mura hua pani ka molecule, surkh O aur do neele H, O par delta-minus aur har H par delta-plus. Teen pados ke pani ke molecules dashed purple hydrogen bonds se jure. Daen: paanch unwanat mukhtasar notes ke saath: hararati mustahkami (zyada specific heat capacity aur heat of vaporisation); solvent (NO3- aur PO4 3- jaise ions, polar pesticides); amphoteric (25 C par Kw = 1.0 x 10^-14); oxygen (DO, BOD, COD); redox potential (oxygen ho to SO4 2- aur CO2, kam ho to H2S aur NH3).
blocks.caption: Pani: polar molecule aur us ki khasiyatein (topic 33.1 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Electrons ki na-barabar sharakat pani ke oxygen sire ko thora manfi aur hydrogen siron ko thora musbat banati hai. Molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds pani ki zyada heat capacity ki wajah hain, aur polarity batati hai ke yeh itne zyada maddey, aaloodgi samet, kyun gholta hai.

items: Dissolved oxygen (DO) pani mein aabi jandaron ke saans lene ke liye dastyab oxygen ki miqdar hai. Yeh pani ke mayaar ka kaleedi ishara hai: zyada DO aam taur par saaf pani, jab ke kam DO aaloodgi ya organic maddah ke zyada galne ki taraf ishara karti hai.

Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) woh oxygen ki miqdar hai jo khurdbeeni jandaron ko pani ka organic maddah aik muqarrara muddat, aam taur par 20 C par paanch din, mein torne ke liye chahiye. Zyada BOD ka matlab organic maddah ki bari miqdar, yani shadeed aaloodgi, jo ghuli oxygen khatam kar ke aabi zindagi ko nuqsan de sakti hai.

Chemical oxygen demand (COD) woh oxygen ki miqdar hai jo pani ke organic aur inorganic maddon ko KMnO4 ya K2Cr2O7 jaise oxidising agents se kimiyai taur par oxidise karne ke liye chahiye. Zyada COD ka matlab sanati ya gharelu kachre se oxidise hone wali kimiyai aaloodgi ka zyada concentration; COD kul aaloodgi ka andaza lagane mein mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt: Samjhayein ke pani ki polarity pesticides jaise zarai aaloodgi ko pani ke chakkar mein dakhil hone mein kaise madad deti hai.
blocks.explanation: Pani polar hai, is liye polar organic compounds aur ions gholta hai; polar pesticides aur herbicides barish aur behte pani mein ghul kar daryaon, jheelon aur zameeni pani tak pohanchte aur wahan der tak rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Pani ke mayaar ke isharon ke taur par BOD aur COD mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: BOD woh oxygen hai jo khurdbeeni jandaar organic maddah torne mein use karte hain (20 C par paanch din), is liye yeh gal sakne wali organic aaloodgi napti hai. COD woh oxygen hai jo K2Cr2O7 jaise taqatwar oxidising agents se organic aur inorganic maddon ko kimiyai taur par oxidise karne ke liye chahiye, is liye yeh kul oxidise hone wala bojh napti hai; COD aam taur par BOD se zyada hoti hai.

items: Pani mustaqil dipole, hydrogen bonds ke saath: hararati mustahkami, gholne ki taqat.
Amphoteric: 25 C par Kw = 1.0 x 10^-14; tezabiyat zehreeli dhatein azad karti.
Zyada DO = saaf; zyada BOD aur COD = aaloodah (Table 33.1).
Kam oxygen: reducing halaat, H2S aur NH3.
